question: Does having two horns make an Oni stronger because their strength only increases when they activate their horns, with an even greater boost when they enter Oni Mode? Or are two-horned Oni stronger than one-horned Oni even in their normal state, and do they receive a greater enhancement than one-horned Oni when they activate their horns?
answer:
The basic setting is that two horns are stronger. However, Ram is an outlier, so even though she only has one horn, she's roughly as strong as ten horns' worth.

So, Rem's combat ability is actually on the lower side among the Oni, but because she has trained her magic and developed other skills, if she were to fight a two-horned Oni, it wouldn't be a completely hopeless matchup. I think she could win by using magic and other skills, such as her morning star.
